summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the data handling logic within the analytics dashboard when selecting specific time zones. It was confirmed that even if a selected time zone is only configured for certain facilities, the system will process all available data in the chosen time zone.

The mechanism involves: 
1. The dashboard listing all time zones present across all facilities, plus UTC and the browser's local zone.
2. Data processing itself occurs based on the explicitly selected time zone.

[me] provided a technical tip that any time zone can be set via command line parameters (e.g., `&timezone=...`), noting that special characters like `/` must be URL-encoded as `%2F`.
decisions: The system correctly processes data based on the selected time zone, regardless of whether all facilities are configured for it.
